Based on the provided context, the automatic life insurance coverage thresholds differ as follows:

*   **GitLab LTD (UK):** The automatic cover threshold is **4x base salary**.
*   **GitLab France S.A.S.:** The context **does not specify** a salary-based multiplier or threshold for the automatic coverage amount. It only states that coverage is effective from the hire date (after a 90-day waiting period) and is 100% employer-paid, but it does not define the value of the coverage in relation to salary.

Therefore, while the UK entity explicitly defines the threshold as 4x base salary, the France entity's context does not provide a comparable salary-based threshold.

[GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Life Insurance and Disability]
GitLab provides company-paid Group Life and Disability Plans through Generali to protect you and your loved ones during unexpected life events. This comprehensive coverage ensures financial security when you need it most.

Eligibility Requirements

- All GitLab France S.A.S. team members
- Coverage effective from your hire date (90-day waiting period)

Coverage & Key Features

- Life Insurance coverage
- Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) benefits
- Short-term and Long-term Disability protection
- 100% employer-paid premiums
- [View complete plan details](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MBz0k5KkXC2GeITvh2uXNXjMJE07TU3_9MTp8N9MlwM/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.uewazgm9e8qx) and [policy documents](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jNFYcn2CLWHpPolvGTEz21FCQKIYBsbq/view?usp=sharing)

How to Enroll/Access

[GitLab LTD (UK) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Life Insurance]
Provides a tax-free lump sum payment to your loved ones, offering peace of mind during difficult times.

Eligibility Requirements

- All team members aged 16 to 75
- Automatic enrollment upon hire

Coverage & Key Features

- The automatic cover threshold for the Group Life Insurance policy is 4x base salary.
- Underwriting: Based on the current non-medical limit of £1,800,000, the salary threshold above which medical underwriting is required is £450,000 (i.e., £1,800,000 ÷ 4).
- Tax-free benefit payment
- Includes Cancer Assist support through Reframe
- View the [Life Insurance Policy Guide](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1D7QXKKvVtafQFbBFD4mPuKqbi1mqBsLh/view?usp=sharing)

How to Access

- Automatically enrolled—no action needed
- Designate beneficiaries using the [Expression of Wishes Form](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m68nqgQyZvuY7VoJPo1to5XDpecduJ2y/view?usp=sharing)
- Upload completed form to Workday under "Benefit Documents and Forms"

Medical Underwriting

- Salaries above £450,000 require medical assessment for additional coverage
- Contact total-rewards@gitlab.com if you need coverage above the automatic limit

[GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security: Security You Can Count On > Basic Life Insurance & AD&D]
GitLab provides company-paid basic life insurance valued at two times your annual base salary with a maximum benefit of $500,000, including equal AD&D coverage through Cigna/New York Life. See the [**US Benefits Guide**](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15L8LMWI1CoUUoU3DcimxU3edITKs8QrV/view) for plan details and costs.

- Automatic coverage from day one
- [Survivor assurance and support services](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Uhh7S9uotOtHxogCh7Z7AmLfgdufLsig/view?usp=sharing) included
